title: N -W F P Universities Amendment Act 1992

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Universities Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1992
ACT VIII OF 1992
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE UNIVERSITIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the enactments relating to the Universities in
the North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 27th September, 1992]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/92/19462-63,
dated 27-9-1992.--The North West Frontier Province Universities (Amendment)
Bill, 1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West
Frontier Province on the 8th September, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of
the North-West Frontier Province on the 23rd September, 1992 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
1. Short title and commencement.---This Act may be called the
North-West Frontier Province Universities (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
